summary: The United Methodist Church's Articles of Religion teach that the visible church of Christ is a congregation of faithful men in which the pure Word of God is preached and the sacraments duly administered according to Christ's ordinance. The Articles do not describe church government or who may be ordained, which the Book of Discipline handles.

points.question: Where is the true church?
points.answer: The visible church of Christ is a congregation of faithful men in which the pure Word of God is preached and the sacraments duly administered according to Christ's ordinance.

scriptureNote: The Articles of Religion do not print scripture references.

document.title: The Articles of Religion of the Methodist Church
document.date: 1784 (John Wesley's revision of the Church of England's articles)

rights.note: The article dates from 1784 and is long out of copyright. The UMC Book of Discipline as a whole is copyrighted and is not used.

review.note: Article XIII read on umc.org on 2026-11-12. The Book of Discipline, which sets out the UMC's government and ordination of women and men, was not used and is under copyright. Not yet checked by a second reviewer.
